states.claim: gview_ is initialized from the graph and provides node lookup for the executor state.
cf_info holds control-flow frame information built from the graph.
root_frame_info_ points to the FrameInfo for the empty frame name stored in frame_info_.
pending_ids_ is resized to hold one pending-count handle per graph node.
item points to the NodeItem owned by gview_ for node id.
item->kernel is set to the kernel created by params_.create_kernel; on failure it is set to nullptr.
states.evidence:
L49: Status s = params_.create_kernel(n->properties(), &item->kernel);
L51: item->kernel = nullptr;

states.claim: const_tensors_ holds a shallow copy of the kernel's constant tensor, and item->const_tensor points to that tensor.
enter_frame_info_ is resized to at least id+1 and stores the FrameInfo pointer for the Enter node at index id.
pending_ids_[id] is a handle allocated in frame_info->pending_counts_layout.
root_nodes_ contains item for nodes with no input edges.
frame_info->nodes contains item for the node's frame.
item->outputs_required owns a bool array recording which outputs are used.
states.evidence:
L139: std::unique_ptr<bool[]> outputs_required(new bool[n->num_outputs()]);
L157: item->outputs_required = std::move(outputs_required);

states.claim: Each EdgeInfo in item->mutable_output_edges() has its input_slot rewritten to refer to the destination NodeItem's input location.

values.claim: pending_ids_ is resized to gview_.num_nodes() elements, establishing the valid index range [0, gview_.num_nodes()) for pending_ids_[id].
id is n->id() and is used to index cf_info.frame_names, gview_.node(id), pending_ids_[id], and enter_frame_info_, so id must be within the bounds of each of those containers.
enter_frame_info_ is resized to id + 1 when its size is <= id, ensuring index id is valid before assignment.
item->input_start is set to frame_info->total_inputs, then frame_info->total_inputs is incremented by n->num_inputs(), so input_start values are cumulative offsets into the frame's input space.
values.evidence:
L46: item->input_start = frame_info->total_inputs;
L47: frame_info->total_inputs += n->num_inputs();

values.claim: e.input_slot is rewritten as e.input_slot + dst_item->input_start, where dst_item = gview_.node(e.dst_id), converting a per-node input slot into a frame-global input offset.
outputs_required is a bool array of length n->num_outputs(), and e->src_output() is used to index it, so e->src_output() must be in [0, n->num_outputs()).
unused_outputs is initialized to n->num_outputs() and decremented once per distinct used output, so it counts outputs not consumed by any non-sink edge.
The loop index i ranges over [0, n->num_outputs()) and indexes outputs_required[i], matching the array length n->num_outputs().
